caseName: Stine v. Missouri State Life Insurance
caseNameFull: Martha L. Stine, in Error v. Missouri State Life Insurance Company
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Missouri.
attorneys: Mr. Frederick N. Judson and Mr. John F. Green for the plaintiff in error. Mr. James C. Jones for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Cornell v. Green, 163 U. S. 75, 79-80; Arkansas v. Schlierholz, 179 U. S. 598, 601; Lampasas v. Bell, 180 *643U. S. 276, 282; Itow v. United States, 233 U. S. 581, 583-584.

Mr. Frederick N. Judson and Mr. John F. Green for the plaintiff in error. Mr. James C. Jones for the defendant in error.
